$comment: SessionStart bootstrap for the DCOE roster. Agent bodies deliberately live OUTSIDE this plugin (agent-bodies-reference/ at repo root) so the plugin loader never scans them — see docs/specs/2026-07-29-strip-dcoe-roster-agent-bodies.md, which removed dcoe-roster/agents/ to stop each agent being listed three times. This hook restores the bootstrap role that strip gave up, without reintroducing the duplicate listing. Spec: docs/specs/2026-08-09-universal-roster-and-codex-gate.md in the Claude-Code hub. The existence guard below is required because Claude Code executes installed plugins from its per-plugin cache (~/.claude/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<sha>/), which does not include repo-root siblings like agent-bodies-reference/ — only a full git checkout (e.g. plugins/marketplaces/) has it. Without the guard, node throws an uncaught MODULE_NOT_FOUND on every session start wherever the plugin runs from cache. See docs/specs/2026-08-20-hook-crash-cache-relative-path.md.
